links.outcome: Readability (FRES, FKGL) of ChatGPT answers to patient questions on distal biceps repair
links.effect: FRES 24.49 (Fact), 22.82 (Policy), 21.77 (Value); FKGL 14.96, 14.78, 15.00, roughly college-graduate reading level.
links.quote: The accuracy and reliability of these answers were shown to be low, with nearly a college-graduate level of readability.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT 3.5's quality, reliability, and readability when answering patient questions about distal biceps tendon repair surgery, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
